"""Orchestrator agent — coordinates everyone else.""" from __future__ import annotations
import asyncio
from ..state import DemoState from ..ui import ParallelWritersView, WriterRow, beat, section from .analyzer import AnalyzerAgent from .base import Agent from .coverage import CoverageAgent from .devops import DevOpsAgent from .reviewer import ReviewerAgent from .sonar import SonarAgent from .writer import WriterAgent
class OrchestratorAgent(Agent): id = "orchestrator"
def __init__(self, settings, llm): super().__init__(settings, llm) self.analyzer = AnalyzerAgent(settings, llm) self.writers = [ WriterAgent(settings, llm, category="producer"), WriterAgent(settings, llm, category="consumer"), WriterAgent(settings, llm, category="integration"), ] self.coverage = CoverageAgent(settings, llm) self.sonar = SonarAgent(settings, llm) self.reviewer = ReviewerAgent(settings, llm) self.devops = DevOpsAgent(settings, llm)
async def run(self, state: DemoState) -> None: # ------------------------------------------------------------------ section("1. PLAN") self.say(f"Routing work for repo: {state.repo}") await self.analyzer.run(state)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ section("2. CREATE BRANCH") await self.devops.prepare_branch(state)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ section("3. PARALLEL WRITERS") await self._dispatch_writers(state) await self.devops.commit(state, "test: scaffold JUnit suite via agentic AI")
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ for loop in range(self.settings.max_loops): state.iterations = loop section(f"4. QUALITY GATE — pass {loop + 1}") await self.coverage.run(state) await self.sonar.run(state) await self.reviewer.run(state)
if (state.sonar and state.sonar.passed and (not state.coverage or state.coverage.overall_pct >= self.settings.coverage_threshold) and not state.review): self.say("All gates green. Proceeding to merge.", level="success") break
section(f"5. TARGETED FIX — pass {loop + 1}") await self._fix_failures(state) await self.devops.commit( state, f"test: address review feedback & coverage gaps (pass {loop + 1})", ) else: self.say(f"Reached max loops ({self.settings.max_loops}). Aborting.", level="error") return
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ section("6. OPEN PR") await self.devops.open_pr(state)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------- async def _dispatch_writers(self, state: DemoState) -> None: rows = [WriterRow(name=w.id, status="queued", detail="") for w in self.writers] view = ParallelWritersView(rows)
async def run_writer(w: WriterAgent): view.update(w.id, status="running", detail="drafting…") await w.run(state) cnt = sum(1 for t in state.tests if t.written_by == w.id) view.update(w.id, status="done", detail=f"{cnt} test class(es) written")
if self.settings.headless: await asyncio.gather(*(run_writer(w) for w in self.writers)) else: with view.live(): await asyncio.gather(*(run_writer(w) for w in self.writers)) await beat(self.settings.tick(0.4))
async def _fix_failures(self, state: DemoState) -> None: # Mock LLM hint for demo narration await self.llm.complete( system="You are a senior engineer fixing review and quality findings.", user="Apply targeted fixes for the latest review and quality gate output (key 'fix').", )
# In mock mode, append simple comments to the affected test files so # there's a real diff for the next commit. notes = [ ("src/test/java/com/fooddelivery/producer/OrderServiceTest.java", "// agent: added invalid-transition coverage in pass " + str(state.iterations + 1) + "\n"), ("src/test/java/com/fooddelivery/OrderLifecycleIntegrationTest.java", "// agent: added partition-stability assertion in pass " + str(state.iterations + 1) + "\n"), ] for rel, note in notes: target = state.repo / rel if target.exists(): target.write_text(target.read_text() + note, encoding="utf-8") self.say(f"Patched {rel}", level="success") await beat(self.settings.tick(0.4))

"""LLM client abstraction with mock / openai / anthropic / ollama providers.
All providers share the same interface so agents are provider-agnostic. A `TracedLLM` wrapper records every call into Langfuse (or the local JSONL fallback) so the demo is observable end-to-end. """ from __future__ import annotations
import os import time from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from . import ollama_utils from .tracing import get_tracer
class LLMClient(ABC): name: str model: str = "n/a"
@abstractmethod async def complete(self, system: str, user: str, *, temperature: float = 0.2) -> str: ...
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- # Mock provider — deterministic, offline. Returns canned narrative responses # keyed by simple substring detection in the prompt. Great for stage demos. # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- class MockLLM(LLMClient): name = "mock" model = "mock-canned-v1"
_CANNED = { "test plan": ( "Plan:\n" " 1. OrderServiceTest – verify each transition publishes the right event.\n" " 2. RestaurantServiceTest – verify only PLACED/ACCEPTED/PREPARING are handled.\n" " 3. DeliveryServiceTest – verify PREPARING/OUT_FOR_DELIVERY/DELIVERED handled.\n" " 4. NotificationServiceTest – verify a message is produced for every state.\n" " 5. OrderLifecycleIntegrationTest – embedded Kafka, full PLACED→DELIVERED." ), "review": ( "LGTM overall. Two suggestions:\n" " - assert partition is stable for the same orderId.\n" " - cover invalid transition (DELIVERED → PREPARING)." ), "fix": "Adding test for invalid state transition + asserting partition stability.", }
async def complete(self, system: str, user: str, *, temperature: float = 0.2) -> str: low = (system + "\n" + user).lower() for k, v in self._CANNED.items(): if k in low: return v return "OK."
class OpenAILLM(LLMClient): name = "openai"
def __init__(self, model: str = "gpt-4o-mini"): from openai import AsyncOpenAI # type: ignore self._client = AsyncOpenAI() self.model = model
async def complete(self, system: str, user: str, *, temperature: float = 0.2) -> str: resp = await self._client.chat.completions.create( model=self.model, temperature=temperature, messages=[ {"role": "system", "content": system}, {"role": "user", "content": user}, ], ) return resp.choices[0].message.content or ""
class AnthropicLLM(LLMClient): name = "anthropic"
def __init__(self, model: str = "claude-3-5-haiku-latest"): import anthropic # type: ignore self._client = anthropic.AsyncAnthropic() self.model = model
async def complete(self, system: str, user: str, *, temperature: float = 0.2) -> str: msg = await self._client.messages.create( model=self.model, max_tokens=1024, temperature=temperature, system=system, messages=[{"role": "user", "content": user}], ) return "".join(block.text for block in msg.content if hasattr(block, "text"))
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- # Ollama (local) — uses the OpenAI-compatible endpoint at /v1 # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- class OllamaLLM(LLMClient): name = "ollama"
def __init__(self, model: str, base_url: str = "http://localhost:11434"): from openai import AsyncOpenAI # type: ignore self._client = AsyncOpenAI( base_url=f"{base_url.rstrip('/')}/v1", api_key="ollama", # Ollama ignores it but the SDK requires non-empty ) self.model = model self.base_url = base_url
async def complete(self, system: str, user: str, *, temperature: float = 0.2) -> str: resp = await self._client.chat.completions.create( model=self.model, temperature=temperature, messages=[ {"role": "system", "content": system}, {"role": "user", "content": user}, ], timeout=600, ) return resp.choices[0].message.content or ""
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- # Tracing wrapper — transparent to agents # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- class TracedLLM(LLMClient): """Wraps any LLMClient, emitting a generation record per call."""
def __init__(self, inner: LLMClient, agent_id: str = "unknown"): self.inner = inner self.name = inner.name self.model = inner.model self.agent_id = agent_id
def for_agent(self, agent_id: str) -> "TracedLLM": """Return a sibling view with a different agent label.""" return TracedLLM(self.inner, agent_id=agent_id)
async def complete(self, system: str, user: str, *, temperature: float = 0.2) -> str: t0 = time.time() try: output = await self.inner.complete(system, user, temperature=temperature) except Exception as e: # pragma: no cover tracer = get_tracer() if tracer: tracer.log_generation( agent_id=self.agent_id, model=self.inner.model, system=system, user=user, output=f"<<error: {e}>>", latency_ms=int((time.time() - t0) * 1000), provider=self.inner.name, ) raise latency_ms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000) tracer = get_tracer() if tracer: tracer.log_generation( agent_id=self.agent_id, model=self.inner.model, system=system, user=user, output=output, latency_ms=latency_ms, provider=self.inner.name, ) return output
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- # Factory # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- def make_llm(provider: str, *, ollama_model: str | None = None, ollama_base_url: str = "http://localhost:11434") -> LLMClient: provider = (provider or "mock").lower() if provider == "openai": if not os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"): raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is not set") return OpenAILLM() if provider == "anthropic": if not os.environ.get("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"): raise RuntimeError("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is not set") return AnthropicLLM() if provider == "ollama": # Ensure server up, auto-pick a model if user didn't specify one. ollama_utils.ensure_server_running(ollama_base_url) model = ollama_model or ollama_utils.pick_best_model(ollama_base_url) if not model: raise RuntimeError( "No Ollama models installed. Run e.g.\n" " ollama pull qwen2.5-coder:7b\n" "or pass --ollama-model <name>." ) return OllamaLLM(model=model, base_url=ollama_base_url) return MockLLM()
